purpose.text: Sends chat requests to Meta or Baseten, handles retries and response-format fallback, prices usage, and logs every billed call.
Removes a whole secret or any sufficiently long piece of it from text before that text is kept or shown.
Limits model use by hourly calls, experiments per session, and total spend, including reservations for concurrent calls.
Refuses contributor or otherwise disallowed models and enforces prompt-size and estimated-cost limits before code is sent.
Defines the strict zod shapes for model-returned bets, experiments, adversary proposals, and proposer tests.
Builds the Claimant prompt, validates its experiment and bets against plain-code questions, seals accepted bets, and supplies the hand-written fixture finding.
Asks the model to bet on an already chosen experiment, validates one bet per question, and seals the accepted bets.
Asks a model to propose up to three code findings, verifies each quoted place with plain code, and falls back to another model when needed.
Asks a model for one additional experiment after a run, then applies schema, gate, question, and repeat checks before accepting it.
Asks Muse Wonder to propose tests for a selected function in pasted code and keeps gate-allowed and gate-refused proposals separate.
Asks Muse Wonder to propose a codebase outline from files and a plain-code map, subject to code-model, prompt, and cost guards.
Runs Muse Code headlessly in a restricted scratch workspace or falls back to chat, then keeps only a plain-code-checked unified diff.

labels.parts: Parts, names, purposes and patterns: muse-wonder-1.0's words. "confirmed" means plain code found these lines in the code, on whole definitions; it does not mean the purpose is true.
labels.joins: confirmed: Wonder said it and plain code found an import, call or use inside the first part's lines reaching the second part's lines. model-only: "Wonder says this; plain code could not check it" (the reason says why), or, when marked noLinkFound, "Atlas found no import or call for this". code-only: found by plain code; Wonder did not say it. A "data" join is linked either direction.
